Metadata.title: Daily Alibi
Metadata.description: A new murder mystery every day. Question AI suspects, examine the evidence, name the killer.

Home.tagline: A new murder every morning. Twenty questions. One accusation.
Home.noCase: No case today yet. Come back soon, or try one from the archive.

steps.read: Read the case file and examine the evidence. That's free.
steps.ask: Question the four suspects. You have 20 questions in total, so choose them well.
steps.note: Pin statements and answers in your notebook to catch contradictions.
steps.accuse: Name the killer, the motive and the key evidence. You get one accusation.

Home.daily: A new case every day at midnight (UTC). Everyone gets the same one.

Case.evidenceHint: Examining evidence is free. It costs none of your questions.

NotFound.title: Nothing here. The trail has gone cold.

Interrogation.title: Interrogation
Interrogation.intro: Question the suspects. Every question, to anyone, uses one of your twenty.
Interrogation.askedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Not questioned yet} one {# question} other {# questions}}
Interrogation.empty: {name} is waiting for your first question.
Interrogation.noQuestionsLeft: You have used all your questions. Time to make your accusation.

errors.invalid_request: That question could not be sent. Keep it under 280 characters.
errors.case_not_found: This case could not be found.
errors.suspect_not_found: This suspect could not be found.
errors.busy: Wait for the current answer first.
errors.ai_unavailable: The suspect is not answering right now. Your question was not counted; please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many detectives are asking questions right now. Wait a minute and try again; your question was not counted.
errors.game_over: This case is closed for you: you've already made your accusation.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Please try again.
